lessons.name: per_seat_vs_flat_rate_objection
lessons.description: Objection: 'your pricing is per-seat, competitor is flat-rate'
lessons.applies_when: A prospect compares our per-seat pricing unfavorably to a competitor's flat-rate plan, usually while projecting their headcount growth over the contract term.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the prospect has an explicit hard budget cap independent of headcount -- there, address the cap directly instead.

lessons.name: security_questionnaire_request
lessons.applies_when: An enterprise prospect's security/procurement team sends a vendor security questionnaire (or asks for a SOC 2 report) before the deal can move to legal review.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to prospects in a regulated industry requiring a custom on-site audit -- that needs security/legal involvement beyond the standard packet.

lessons.name: champion_goes_dark
lessons.applies_when: An engaged champion who was driving the deal internally suddenly stops responding for one to several weeks, with no explanation, partway through an otherwise-healthy cycle.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply in the first week of silence during a known internal freeze period (e.g. year-end) -- give it the stated window first.

lessons.name: multiyear_discount_approval
lessons.description: Multi-year discount request above exec approval threshold
lessons.applies_when: A prospect asks for a discount on a multi-year commitment that exceeds the rep's standing approval authority, and the deal needs to move through an approval workflow without stalling.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to single-year discount requests within standard approval authority, which don't need the extra packaging.

lessons.name: msa_indemnification_redline
lessons.applies_when: Customer procurement/legal returns the MSA with the indemnification clause redlined, most often asking to remove or raise the standard liability cap.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to redlines on clauses other than indemnification/liability (e.g. data processing terms), which route to a different specialist.

lessons.name: renewal_at_risk_low_adoption
lessons.description: Renewal at risk due to low product adoption
lessons.applies_when: A renewal is approaching (usually within 60-90 days) and usage/adoption data shows the account under-using the product relative to its contract size, putting the renewal at risk.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when low usage reflects a genuine mismatch between the purchased tier and the account's actual needs -- that's a downsell/renewal restructuring conversation, not an adoption push.
